description: This file provides a fake implementation of the SearchContentsRepository interface for testing purposes within the 'Now in Android' project. It includes methods to populate data, perform search queries, and get content counts, with stub implementations using Kotlin flows.

classes.name: FakeSearchContentsRepository
classes.description: A fake implementation of the SearchContentsRepository interface used for testing, providing stubbed methods to simulate data operations.

methods.name: populateFtsData
methods.description: Stub method to simulate populating full-text search data; does nothing.

methods.name: searchContents
methods.description: Returns an empty flow of SearchResult, simulating a search operation with no results.

methods.name: getSearchContentsCount
methods.description: Returns a flow emitting the integer 1, representing a fixed count of search contents.
